description: Defines functions and classes for converting media::DecoderBuffers to and from Mojo DataPipes, including MojoDecoderBufferReader and MojoDecoderBufferWriter classes, used for inter-process communication of media buffers in Chromium.

classes.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader
classes.description: Reads mojom::DecoderBuffer objects from a Mojo DataPipe and converts them into media::DecoderBuffer objects.

classes.name: MojoDecoderBufferWriter
classes.description: Converts media::DecoderBuffer objects into mojom::DecoderBuffer objects and writes them into a Mojo DataPipe.

methods.name: CreateDataPipe
methods.description: Creates a Mojo DataPipe with specified capacity and sets producer and consumer handles.

methods.name: GetDefaultDecoderBufferConverterCapacity
methods.description: Returns default capacity for MojoDecoderBufferReader and MojoDecoderBufferWriter based on DemuxerStream type.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader::Create
methods.description: Creates a MojoDecoderBufferReader with specified capacity and producer handle.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader::ReadDecoderBuffer
methods.description: Enqueues a mojom::DecoderBuffer for reading and sets a callback to receive the converted media::DecoderBuffer.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader::Flush
methods.description: Reads all pending data and fires all callbacks, then fires the flush callback.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferWriter::Create
methods.description: Creates a MojoDecoderBufferWriter with specified capacity and producer handle.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferWriter::WriteDecoderBuffer
methods.description: Converts a media::DecoderBuffer into mojom::DecoderBuffer and enqueues it for writing.
